mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_source WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_source SET title=#{title},source_kind=#{sourceKind},extraction_status=#{extractionStatus},origin_url=#{originUrl},origin_note=#{originNote},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW(),remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_exam_source(source_id,subject,grade,exam_type,exam_year,school_name,scope_note,authenticity_status,verification_note) VALUES(#{id},#{subject},#{grade},#{examType},#{examYear},#{schoolName},#{scopeNote},#{authenticityStatus},#{verificationNote}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE subject=VALUES(subject),grade=VALUES(grade),exam_type=VALUES(exam_type),exam_year=VALUES(exam_year),school_name=VALUES(school_name),scope_note=VALUES(scope_note),authenticity_status=VALUES(authenticity_status),verification_note=VALUES(verification_note)
mapper.select: SELECT source_id AS sourceId,asset_id AS assetId,role FROM kb_source_asset WHERE source_id=#{id} ORDER BY asset_id,role

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_source WHERE source_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_material_reference_source WHERE source_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product_reference_source WHERE source_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_render_job j, JSON_TABLE(j.config_snapshot_json, '$.productCatalog.referenceSources[*]' COLUMNS(source_id BIGINT PATH '$.sourceId')) r WHERE r.source_id=#{id})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_source WHERE source_id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_source WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND evidence_asset_id=#{assetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_source SET extraction_status='PARTIAL',row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND extraction_status='ORIGINAL_ONLY'
